options.name: local_path
options.description: The path on the F5OS where the the tenant image is to be uploaded.

options.name: remote_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the remote server on which the tenant image is stored. The server must make the image accessible via the specified C(protocol).

options.name: remote_password
options.description: Password for the user on the remote server on which the tenant image is stored.

options.name: remote_path
options.description: The path to the tenant image on the remote server.

options.name: remote_port
options.description: The port on the remote host to which you want to connect. If the port is not provided, a default port for the selected C(protocol) is used.

options.name: remote_user
options.description: User name for the remote server on which the tenant image is stored.

options.name: state
options.description: The tenant image state. If C(import), starts the image import task if the image does not exist. If C(present), checks for the status of the import task if the image does not exist. If C(absent), deletes the tenant image if it exists.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The number of seconds to wait for image import to finish. The accepted value range is between C(150) and C(3600) seconds.
